_doc: Per-basin Polluted River Stretch (PRS) sources. To onboard a new river's PRS, add a basin entry here and run `python scripts/build_prs.py <basinId>` - no code change. Each year entry: the source line geometry (any OGR-readable format), its survey year, and the CPCB/NGT priority band (I = worst). Output goes to public/data/basins/<basinId>/prs.geojson and is consumed by the generic `prs` layer + PRSPanel.
